baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ق د ر at words 2 and 5 is qualified by حَقَّ and answered by قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause stages an attempted measurement, requires that measurement to match reality, then supplies gathered force and prevailing efficacy as the result that exceeds the attempted bound.

activation_trace.role: A quantity that brings a thing to its limit supplies the human scale and the upper bound that fails.
Reality-matching fixity makes truth, rather than human impression, the criterion of the estimate.
Strength gathered like the capacities of a rope supplies coherent force that the proposed scale cannot contain.
Prevailing over opposition turns capacity into an externally unopposed outcome.

changed_reading.before: They failed to esteem God highly enough.
changed_reading.after: They used a bounded scale whose result is falsified by coherent, prevailing power; the defect lies in the measuring frame, not only in the amount of praise.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱللَّهَ is the direct object of قَدَرُوا۟, while حَقَّ makes the appraisal a due owed to its object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Worship, obligatory right, and effective sovereignty combine to make appraisal performative: recognition is shown by yielding the allegiance warranted by the one appraised.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one makes the missed measure a failure of directed worship, not a detached numerical error.
A binding due turns correct appraisal into an obligation that can be withheld.
Effective capacity, possession, and command identify what the withheld due should acknowledge.
Might and inviolable standing make refusal of the due an inversion of actual rank.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an inaccurate opinion about God.
changed_reading.after: The verse indicts a practical withholding of God's due rank and worship from the one whose effective sovereignty warrants them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognate repetition قَدَرُوا۟ ... قَدْرِهِۦ makes the act of measuring answer to the measured one's own measure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Images of correspondence and a right-fitting joint recast the failure as instrument-object mismatch: even a large estimate is false if its categories do not fit what is being measured.

activation_trace.role: Coming in accordance with a proper measure supplies the calibration relation between estimate and object.
A right that fits its exact place like a joint or receptacle supplies the image of structural fit.
Integrated strength is the feature the ill-fitted instrument fails to register.

changed_reading.before: Their estimate is simply too small.
changed_reading.after: Their estimate is structurally miscalibrated: its categories do not fit the reality being assessed, regardless of how emphatically it is stated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing pair قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ follows the failed appraisal as its causal correction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two predicates are not redundant: ق و ي supplies internally gathered capacity, while ع ز ز supplies the passage from capacity to prevailing, reinforced efficacy against resistance.

activation_trace.role: Gathered strands of force supply the internal capacity stage.
Overcoming opposition supplies the external efficacy stage.
Reinforcement makes the second predicate intensify and operationalize the first rather than merely repeat it.

changed_reading.before: Strong and mighty are two synonymous honorifics.
changed_reading.after: The pair gives a two-stage profile: force is coherently present and then proves irreducible by resistance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding parable constructs a failed comparison class: aggregated claimants cannot perform even measured creation or recover a tiny loss, and both ends of their dependency are weak. The focus verdict therefore rejects the scale that lets such agents be compared with God at all.

activation_trace.role: The focus root supplies the scale whose comparison class is exposed as invalid.
Coherently gathered force answers the parable's aggregation of agencies that remains powerless.
Creation as prior measuring and shaping makes inability to create an inability to originate even a workable measure.
The gathering of separate capacities tests whether aggregation can become effective force; here it cannot.
Failure to extract a thing from another's hold supplies a concrete test of ineffective agency.
Weakness as the direct contrary of force sets the parable's agents against the focus predicate قَوِىٌّ.
Seeking and being sought form a reciprocal dependency in which neither side controls the desired outcome.

structural_cues: 22:73 immediately precedes the focus and ends with the explicit weakness of both seeker and sought.
The branchless theft cue in 22:73 makes loss and failed recovery the parable's material test.
The focus answers ضَعُفَ with قَوِىٌّ before closing with عَزِيزٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aggregation, failed creation, failed recovery, and reciprocal weakness; I infer that adjacency makes this a calibration test for قَدَرُوا۟; a live alternative is that the parable only condemns the invoked objects while the focus gives a general conclusion.

changed_reading.before: People underestimate God's degree of power.
changed_reading.after: People commit a comparison error: they place dependent, aggregatively weak agents on the same scale as the source of effective force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact closing pair has already appeared where force prevents the demolition of worship sites and vindicates expelled people. That recurrence gives the focus predicates an operational profile: strength is counterforce that preserves vulnerable worship rather than naked domination.

activation_trace.role: The focus predicate carries the gathered capacity whose earlier operation can specify it.
Prevailing efficacy completes the protective action against destructive opposition.
Turning away a harmful force supplies the earlier refrain's protective action.
The threatened collapse of built places supplies the concrete harm that force prevents.
Vindicating the wronged turns superior force toward restoration rather than self-display.
The earlier identical predicate attaches coherent capacity directly to the protective sequence.
The earlier identical predicate marks protection as able to prevail over the demolishing force.

structural_cues: 22:40 and 22:74 end with the exact sequence إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ.
In 22:40 the refrain follows expulsion, reciprocal defense, threatened demolition, and promised help.
The protected list spans multiple named kinds of worship site rather than a single private beneficiary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact refrain attached first to defense and then to failed appraisal; I infer that repetition imports the earlier operational profile into the focus; a live alternative is that the phrase recurs only as a general assurance of capacity.

changed_reading.before: The closing attributes assert maximal force in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: The closing attributes recall force that checks destructive force, vindicates the wronged, and preserves spaces of worship; mismeasurement misses what power is for as well as how great it is.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human haste and explicit counting are set against a divine day compared with a thousand counted years. This activates ق د ر as temporal calibration: impatience mistakes a human clock for the measure of divine efficacy.

activation_trace.role: Quantity, limit, and term allow the failed measure to include duration.
Calculation and deliberate estimation supply the mistaken human timing model.
Hastening exposes the behavioral consequence of assuming the wrong time scale.
Counting supplies the explicit human operation by which the thousand-year comparison is framed.

structural_cues: 22:47 juxtaposes demands for haste with a direct one-day-to-one-thousand-years comparison.
The focus repeats the measurement root twice, allowing the earlier numerical comparison to remain latent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies haste and an explicit mismatch between divine and human counting; I infer that this mismatch is one domain of the failed measure in 22:74; a live alternative is that 22:47 concerns patience and promise-keeping without specifying the later appraisal formula.

changed_reading.before: Failure to measure God concerns only magnitude of force.
changed_reading.after: Failure also concerns timing: delayed manifestation is misread as diminished power because the observer uses the wrong temporal scale.

context_deltas.mechanism: Life is stabilized through stages until an appointed limit, while the traversable world is directed and the sky is actively withheld from falling. Together these images make divine force a continuously calibrated restraint that holds processes in their viable measure.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate measuring, preparation, and ordering supply the calibration of unfolding processes.
Integrated force supplies the capacity to sustain many held relations at once.
Stabilization supplies the holding phase within staged generation.
An appointed temporal limit supplies the measured release point of the stabilized process.
Directing a thing toward a purpose supplies ordered usability rather than undirected force.
Holding and restraining make non-occurrence an active expression of power.
Falling and coming to rest name the event being continuously withheld.

structural_cues: 22:5 presents a long ordered sequence of formation, stabilization, term, emergence, maturation, decline, and revived earth.
22:65 makes the absence of catastrophe grammatically dependent on active holding and permission.
Both sequences combine motion with limits rather than depicting force as a single impact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staged stabilization, appointed limits, directed motion, and withheld falling; I infer that their common mechanism is calibrated sustaining force; a live alternative is that the two passages independently illustrate creation and mercy without defining قَوِىٌّ in the focus.

changed_reading.before: Strength is most visible when it breaks resistance.
changed_reading.after: Strength is also the exact restraint by which development reaches its term, motion remains useful, and catastrophic falling does not occur.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah explicitly opposes God as fixed reality to what is invoked besides Him as lacking truth and stability, then describes worship without compelling warrant or disclosed knowledge. The focus failure is therefore not merely a low score but the category error of treating truth and nontruth as commensurable claimants.

activation_trace.role: The act of assigning a measure supplies the comparison operation under indictment.
Reality-matching truth supplies the criterion that blocks a shared scale with the unreal.
The explicit identification of God with stable reality establishes one side of the categorical contrast.
Departure from truth and stability establishes the invoked alternatives as a different category, not a smaller degree.
Submissive worship shows the practical allocation produced by the faulty comparison.
The absence of compelling proof removes an evidential basis for the alternative objects' claim.
The absence of disclosed knowledge makes the wrong worship an appraisal without cognitive uncovering.

structural_cues: 22:62 uses an explicit ٱلْحَقُّ versus ٱلْبَٰطِلُ antithesis.
22:71 repeats worship of what is besides God and negates both authority and knowledge before the fly parable.
The focus places حَقَّ inside the formula that judges the resulting measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth/nontruth antithesis and worship lacking proof or knowledge; I infer that 22:74 diagnoses the comparison itself as malformed; a live alternative is that حَقَّ in the focus denotes only an owed due while the ontological contrast remains background.

changed_reading.before: They rate God below rival powers.
changed_reading.after: They falsely construct a common scale for what is real and what lacks stable truth, then distribute worship according to that malformed comparison.

context_deltas.mechanism: A response measured by likeness is followed by vindication of the wronged and the capacity to leave punishment aside. This revises the force pair: true power can match harm without excess and can refrain without becoming weak.

activation_trace.role: Correspondence to a proper measure supplies calibrated proportionality.
Available force makes restraint a choice rather than incapacity.
Prevailing efficacy ensures that measured response is not imposed by an opponent.
Likeness and equivalence supply the upper bound on retaliatory response.
Vindication directs force toward the party wronged after the measured response.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault supplies power's capacity not to exhaust its available force.

structural_cues: 22:60 places retaliation by the like, promised help, and divine pardon in one compact sequence.
The sequence distinguishes measured redress from both passivity and unlimited retaliation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equivalence, vindication, and pardon; I infer that their adjacency gives a moral calibration to the later force predicates; a live alternative is that these clauses regulate human retaliation without specifying the semantic range of 22:74.

changed_reading.before: To measure God rightly is to imagine force without limit.
changed_reading.after: To measure God rightly includes seeing force that can prevail while remaining proportionate and can pardon without signaling weakness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sits immediately before divine selection of messengers, closed by hearing and seeing. Human appraisal fails; divine appraisal discriminates and chooses from both angels and people with full perceptual access.

activation_trace.role: Deliberative estimation supplies the evaluative operation that fails on the human side of the reversal.
Choosing a select part supplies the successful discriminating operation on the divine side.
Auditory apprehension supplies one axis of complete access surrounding the act of selection.
Visual apprehension supplies the complementary axis of access surrounding the act of selection.

structural_cues: 22:75 directly follows the focus with ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى.
The movement is from plural human failure to singular divine choosing, then to paired perceptual predicates.
22:76 continues with comprehensive knowledge of what lies before and behind the selected agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed human appraisal followed immediately by selective divine appraisal and perceptual predicates; I infer an evaluative reversal across the verse boundary; a live alternative is that messenger selection begins a new topic without commenting on قَدَرُوا۟.

changed_reading.before: The verse only says that humans form too low an estimate.
changed_reading.after: The verse also marks an asymmetry of discernment: humans misappraise God, while God distinguishes and commissions agents with complete access to what He selects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later exact pattern حَقَّ plus a possessed verbal noun turns due measure into due exertion, while worship, the removal of constriction, and holding fast prevent that exertion from becoming unbounded strain. Appraisal becomes embodied, proportionate allegiance.

activation_trace.role: A binding due supplies the relational obligation in the focus formula.
The object's proper measure supplies the proportion to which response must answer.
Submissive worship supplies the enacted form of recognizing the due.
The repeated due construction links proper appraisal to an obligation of response.
Exerting available capacity under difficulty supplies the response demanded by the echoed formula.
The explicit negation of constriction prevents due exertion from being read as crushing maximalism.
A protective holding fast supplies dependence on divine support within the demanded response.

structural_cues: 22:74 has حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ and 22:78 has حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ, the same حَقَّ plus possessed verbal-noun frame.
22:77-78 move through bowing, prostration, worship, good action, exertion, no constriction, and holding fast.
The closing commands convert the surah's evaluative language into bodily and communal practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact constructional echo plus embodied commands and a no-constriction clause; I infer that the later phrase answers failed appraisal with proportionate practice; a live alternative is that the two حَقَّ formulas are parallel intensifiers without a deliberate reciprocal relation.

changed_reading.before: Right measure is an inward judgment about divine greatness.
changed_reading.after: Right measure has an enacted correlate: worship and strenuous response proportioned to their object, yet bounded by the text's denial of constriction and its command to hold fast.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a craft-like precision branch of ح ق ق rather than the ordinary truth or due senses; it remains anchored in focus حَقَّ and is independently triggered by removal followed by explicit tightening of the signs in 22:52; downstream prose should present it as a lexical-material analogy, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حَقَّ at word 4 can carry the image of tightly made speech, while the double ق د ر can carry deliberate estimation.

activation_trace.role: Tightly woven speech supplies a precision image latent in the focus criterion.
Deliberate measuring and preparation supply the calibration applied to discourse.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the first stage of textual repair.
Making something exact and secure supplies the second stage, in which the signs are tightened after disruption.

changed_reading.before: حَقَّ only states that the estimate should be true.
changed_reading.after: The focus can faintly evoke an estimate tested like tightly made discourse: disruption is removed, the wording is secured, and the resulting measure must withstand interference.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the syntax most naturally presents appraisal, not literal constriction; it remains anchored in the packet's constricting branch of ق د ر and is activated by the later explicit denial of constriction; downstream prose should say that the agents conceptually narrow God, not translate قَدَرُوا۟ directly as constricted.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of ق د ر at words 2 and 5 allow a narrowing branch to shadow the ordinary measure sense.

activation_trace.role: Reducing something to a narrow allowance supplies the image of compressing divine agency into a small conceptual frame.
The later denial of narrowness activates constriction as a live contrast rather than an isolated dictionary possibility.

changed_reading.before: They assign God too little greatness.
changed_reading.after: Their error may be pictured as projection: they compress divine agency into the narrow dimensions of their own religious and causal frame.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the difficult-to-obtain sense of عَزِيز beside the usual mighty sense; it remains anchored in the focus adjective and in the immediately preceding recovery and seeking mechanism; downstream prose should retain it as an anti-acquisition resonance, not claim that inaccessibility exhausts عَزِيز here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَزِيزٌ at word 9 closes a parable organized around seeking, possession, theft, and failed retrieval.

activation_trace.role: Rarity and difficulty of attainment keep God from being treated as an object available on the parable's acquisition scale.
Failed extraction from another's possession exposes the invoked agents' inability to control even a recoverable object.
A sought object distant enough to require pursuit supplies the acquisition frame that the focus adjective exceeds.

changed_reading.before: عَزِيزٌ means only that God defeats opponents.
changed_reading.after: عَزِيزٌ also resists the worshippers' acquisition model: God is not one more sought possession whose availability can be tested like the stolen object in the parable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because it activates the barren-land branch housed under ق و ي beside the adjectival قَوِىٌّ; it remains anchored in that supplied focus inventory and in the surah's concrete alternation between emptied habitation and green earth; downstream prose should mark it as a sound-root resonance about depletion and renewal, never as the direct lexical meaning of قَوِىٌّ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَوِىٌّ at word 8 has a packet branch associated with empty, provision-poor land.

activation_trace.role: Barren emptiness supplies a negative-space resonance within the focus root's inventory.
Vacancy and emptiness make ruined habitation a concrete instance of depleted space.
Fresh green growth supplies the reversal from depleted space to living abundance.

changed_reading.before: Divine strength is inferred only from visible abundance or impact.
changed_reading.after: A distant root resonance lets strength span both emptied habitation and renewed greenness, so current depletion cannot serve as a measure of absent power.

strongest_changes: The fly parable changes underestimation into a failure of comparison: aggregated dependent agents never enter the same scale as effective force.
The exact refrain from 22:40 changes قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ from abstract might into protective counterforce that preserves vulnerable worship.
Staged generation and the held sky change strength from impact alone into calibrated sustaining restraint.
The truth-versus-falsehood antithesis changes a low rating into an ontological category error with practical consequences for worship.
The echo حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ / حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ changes right measure from inward judgment into proportionate embodied response without erasing the no-constriction limit.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated measurement root did not settle into one meaning: scale, due, fit, planning, constriction, temporal calibration, and practical response remained coexisting. The closing force pair likewise stayed plural as prevailing power, protective counterforce, sustaining restraint, and proportionate capacity to pardon.
remaining_uncertainties: حَقَّ can foreground reality, binding due, structural fit, or crafted exactness; the focus grammar supports coexistence but does not force one branch.
The exact 22:40 refrain strongly activates a protective profile, though recurrence alone cannot prove that every detail of its earlier scene transfers to 22:74.
The constructional echo in 22:78 may be a deliberate reciprocal answer or only a shared intensifying formula.
The constriction, anti-acquisition, textual-tightening, and empty-land readings are live branch activations but require explicit downstream qualification because of form or domain distance.
